subject: Learning Methods
title: The Coffee Nap Technique
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Coffee Nap Technique.

hook.text: Drink coffee then at once nap for 20 minutes. You wake as the caffeine kicks in, doubly refreshed.

buildup.text: The Coffee Nap Technique sets up the method, the mechanism, and the learning tradeoff.

discovery.text: Studies show the coffee nap outperforms both coffee alone and naps alone on alertness and performance tests.

twist.text: This only works as a one-time tool, not a daily habit. Relying on it masks genuine sleep need.

climax.text: For a critical afternoon study session after a bad night, try one coffee nap. Then restore full sleep that night.

punchline.text: Coffee plus a 20-minute nap. Emergency use only.

quiz.question: Why is the coffee nap effective?
options: Coffee makes you fall asleep faster
Caffeine peaks as you wake from the nap, combining both benefits
The coffee taste stays in your mouth and keeps you alert
